title: Saraswati-Free Education for Slum Children
leadText: Jan Swabhiman Welfare Society's Saraswati initiative provides free, holistic education to children in slum communities and Pak Hindu refugee camps across Jodhpur, Jaisalmer, and Delhi NCR — so learning is never a luxury.

mantraBox.shloka: पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती। यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः ॥
mantraBox.translation: O Saraswati (Supreme, Mother of knowledge and wisdom)! Bless us with the best knowledge, science and success. Purify our Aatmas with the best of virtues.

introParas: Maa Saraswati – mother of all knowledge – is the divine name of the Supreme for seekers of Vidya.

In India, while education is fundamentally a birthright, it tragically remains an elusive luxury for countless children trapped in the harsh realities of impoverished slum communities. Here, the immediate struggle for survival often eclipses the pursuit of knowledge, diverting young lives from the path of learning. Jan Swabhiman Welfare Society's Saraswati initiative stands as a beacon of hope, passionately dedicated to transforming this stark reality by providing free, holistic education to these underprivileged children.

whyUnique.title: Why Saraswati Is Unique
whyUnique.text: Saraswati is far more than a conventional education mission; it's an emotion that fuels our teams, driving us to ensure the comprehensive growth and development of these young minds who were previously denied their birthright – the opportunity to bloom and transcend the societal barriers of caste and creed. We operate directly within the heart of slum areas, including specialized centers dedicated to children from Pakistani Hindu refugee camps. This ensures we directly address the critical educational needs of those most affected by extreme poverty, social challenges, and adverse environments.

pillars.title: Free & Accessible Education (6 Days a Week)
pillars.desc: We are committed to breaking down financial barriers, ensuring quality education is absolutely free and accessible to every child. Daily classes run six days a week so no cost ever prevents a child from learning.

pillars.title: Essential Learning Resources
pillars.desc: To empower every student, we provide all necessary tools for learning, including free textbooks, notebooks, school bags, and stationery sets.

pillars.title: Computer Classes & Digital Literacy
pillars.desc: In a world where digital literacy is essential, we introduce children to computers through guided hands-on sessions — basic skills, keyboard confidence, and the curiosity to explore tools they may never otherwise encounter.

pillars.title: Holistic Personal Development & Dharma Shiksha
pillars.desc: Each day begins with the sacred Gayatri Mantra and Vedic chants. Regular Dharma Shiksha sessions instill moral integrity, celebrate Bharat's heritage, and cultivate Sanskar in young minds.

pillars.title: Family and Child Counseling
pillars.desc: Recognizing the importance of a supportive home environment, we offer personalized counseling sessions for children and parents, resolving domestic trauma and encouraging regular attendance.

pillars.title: Health & Well-being Support
pillars.desc: Qualified doctors conduct periodic medical checkups, hygiene workshops, and provide free medicines and nutrition supplements to address malnutrition and illnesses in the community.

pillars.title: Sports & Physical Fitness
pillars.desc: We make room for play, yoga, and athletics so children build strength, teamwork, and joy alongside their studies — healthy bodies supporting sharp, focused minds.

pillars.title: Vibrant Cultural Enrichment & Festivals
pillars.desc: Our centers come alive during Deepawali, Holi, and national festivals where children receive festive sweets, gifts, new clothes, and the freedom to celebrate childhood joyfully.

transformation.title: From Darkness to Light: The Saraswati Transformation

points.title: Cultivating Values & Pride
points.desc: Children are not just gaining literacy; they are training to become educated patriots instilled with profound pride in Bharat's culture, spirituality, discipline, and national duty.

points.title: Remarkable Behavioral Shifts
points.desc: Children who once resorted to street language and aggressive survival behaviors have transformed into polite, attentive, and confident students.

points.title: Disruptive to Dedicated Learners
points.desc: They have blossomed into bright young souls who run eagerly to their Shiksha centres every morning, eager to read, recite shlokas, and dream boldly.

specialFocus.title: Special Support For Our Pakistani Hindu Refugee Children
specialFocus.desc: We operate dedicated centers for Hindu children who escaped religious persecution, forced conversions, and atrocities in Pakistan. In collaboration with Pakistan Untold and Dr. Vashi Sharma (IIT Scientist and mentor), we provide free schooling, security, and trauma recovery, preparing them to become scientists, teachers, and changemakers in Bharat.

title: Women Empowerment
leadText: At Jan Swabhiman, we honor Matrishakti – the divine feminine force – as the cornerstone of our families, culture, and Dharma. We serve mothers, widows, and daughters across tribal and underprivileged regions through livelihood, education, and social dignity.

mantraBox.shloka: स्तुता मया वरदा वेदमाता प्रचोदयन्ता पावमानी द्विजानाम् । आयुः प्राण प्रजा पशु कीर्ति द्रविण ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ॥
mantraBox.translation: O Divine Mother of Knowledge, You are Varadā – fulfiller of noble desires, eternal source of wisdom. You grant us life, vital energy, noble progeny, prosperity, and spiritual brilliance.

taglineHeading: When She Rises, the Nation Awakens
introParas: At Jan Swabhiman, we honor Matrishakti not merely as a symbol of care, but as the supreme architect of civilization. When a woman is respected, empowered, and safe, an entire society prospers.

We serve the silent pillars of our people — mothers, widows, young daughters, and abandoned girls — especially across neglected tribal and rural belts where poverty and isolation make them vulnerable to exploitation.

whyUnique.title: Our Holistic Focus on Matrishakti
whyUnique.text: Rather than superficial charity, we build deep self-reliance through economic independence, cultural honour, self-defense empowerment, and family security.

pillars.title: Kanyadaan of Poor & Tribal Daughters
pillars.desc: Organizing sacred Vedic Samuhik Vivahs in tribal areas of Tapi, Dang, and Valsad, freeing poor families from predatory debt and restoring celebration with respect.

pillars.desc: Equipping women with sewing machines, tailoring workshops, and handicraft cooperatives so mothers earn regular, independent incomes from home.

pillars.desc: Ensuring no young girl drops out due to lack of school fees, providing textbooks, bicycles for travel to school, and personalized tutoring.

pillars.title: Supporting Families of Deceased Wage Workers
pillars.desc: Extending direct sustenance pensions, ration supplies, and children's schooling to destitute widows of sewage and daily-wage laborers.

pillars.title: Self-Defense & Safety Awareness

title: Pak Hindu Refugees Rehabilitation
leadText: Thousands of Hindu families in Pakistan live under constant persecution, abductions, and forced conversions. Leaving behind ancestral lands, they cross into Bharat seeking refuge and safety. We stand by these displaced families — providing Seva, shelter, education, and livelihood.

mantraBox.shloka: मित्रस्य मा चक्षुषा सर्वाणि भूतानि समीक्षन्ताम् । मित्रस्याहं चक्षुषा सर्वाणि भूतानि समीक्षे ॥
mantraBox.translation: May all beings look upon me with the eyes of a loving friend. May I also look upon all beings with friendship, compassion, and protective brotherhood.

taglineHeading: Rebuilding Dignity in the Land of Rishis
introParas: Across the border, Hindu families have faced unspeakable religious persecution — abductions of young daughters, blasphemy accusations, and forced conversions. Stripped of fundamental rights, many managed to flee across the Thar desert to Bharat with only the clothes on their backs.

At Jan Swabhiman Welfare Society, in active collaboration with Agniveer and Pakistan Untold, we welcome our displaced brothers and sisters with open arms. We believe shelter is not charity; it is our sacred civilizational duty to ensure they live with honour and swabhiman.

whyUnique.title: Why This Matters
whyUnique.text: Their only 'crime' was holding fast to Sanatan Dharma despite systemic oppression. Their homes were bulldozed, their temples destroyed, and their dignity attacked. Today, on sacred Bharatiya soil, your support allows them to rebuild their lives from scratch, free from fear.

pillars.title: Shelter & Sturdy Dwellings
pillars.desc: Constructing weather-proof huts, tin-roofed shelters, and brick living units with clean flooring for newly arrived refugee families in Jodhpur, Jaisalmer, and Delhi camps.

pillars.title: Self Employment & Livelihood Kits
pillars.desc: Providing sewing machines, handcarts, cycle repair toolkits, and seed capital for micro-enterprises so families become self-reliant immediately.

pillars.title: Education for Refugee Children
pillars.desc: Through our Saraswati Shiksha Centres, refugee boys and girls receive free academic schooling, stationery, books, and computers with joyful Sanskrit sanskar.

pillars.title: Survival Essentials & Ration Supplies
pillars.desc: Providing monthly ration kits (flour, rice, dal, spices, cooking oil), potable drinking water tankers, blankets, and urgent medical aid.

title: Gauseva & Animal Welfare
sanskritTitle: पशून् पाहि – मा ते जीविषुः पशवः सन्तु
leadText: Protect the Voiceless – A Sacred Yajna of Selfless Service. At Jan Swabhiman, Dharma begins where compassion is practiced. Our emergency rescue network and dedicated Noida Gaushala shelter over 100 rescued cows and have treated more than 50,000 animals.

mantraBox.shloka: मा ते जीविषुः पशवः सन्तु जीवतुः। धेनवः सर्वकामधुक् ॥
mantraBox.translation: O Humans, protect those who cannot protect themselves. Harmless, gentle beings—like cows and other creatures—must never be harmed. In protecting animals, you protect Dharma itself.

introParas: The cow is far more than an animal — she is Gaumata, the gentle nurturer, the living symbol of abundance, purity, and motherhood in Sanatan civilization.

Yet on our roads and highways, innocent cattle suffer brutal vehicular accidents, acid attacks, consumption of plastic waste, and the ruthless clutches of illegal slaughter mafia. Our volunteers risk their lives 24 hours a day to respond to calls, treat wounds, and give rescued cows a loving forever home.

whyUnique.title: Why Gaushalas Matter
whyUnique.text: Our Gaushala in Noida provides life-long shelter for old, blind, amputee, and non-lactating cows. Here, no cow is judged by her 'commercial utility'. Every cow receives two daily meals of fresh green fodder, jaggery, clean drinking water, daily medical dressing, and sacred Gau Pujan.

pillars.title: 24x7 Emergency Rescue & Ambulance
pillars.desc: Operating dedicated animal rescue vehicles with hydraulic lifts to transport crushed, injured, and infected cattle from highways to our treatment center.

pillars.title: Noida Gaushala Sanctuary
pillars.desc: A safe, shaded, loving permanent refuge in Noida housing 100+ rescued Gaumatas with veterinary hospital facilities and quarantine sheds.

pillars.title: Nutritious Gau Graas Daily
pillars.desc: Ensuring fresh green grass, wheat bran, mustard cake, jaggery, and mineral supplements for every cow, bull, and orphaned calf.

pillars.title: Veterinary Surgeries & Wound Dressing
pillars.desc: Experienced veterinarians treating maggot wounds, fractures, horn rot, and plastic ingestion surgeries.

pillars.title: Antim Sanskaar with Vedic Dignity
pillars.desc: Ensuring that Gaumatas who pass away receive a sacred, respectful Vedic Antim Sanskaar rather than being abandoned to rot on garbage dumps.

points.title: Healing Broken Limbs
points.desc: Calves crushed on highways regain mobility through specialized splints and round-the-clock physical therapy.

points.title: Restoring Motherly Trust
points.desc: Traumatized cows that feared human touch learn to eat peacefully from the hands of loving sevaks.

points.title: Living Classroom for Children
points.desc: Schools and families visit our Gaushala to perform havan, feed cows, and understand the ecological ethos of Jeevdaya.

specialFocus.desc: We urgently require additional veterinary ambulances to expand our rescue range across Western UP and Delhi NCR. Please email us at mailus@janswabhiman.org if you wish to sponsor a vehicle.

title: Gaushala
leadText: Located in Noida – home to over 100 rescued Gaumatas. At Jan Swabhiman, Gaumata is not just an animal — she is our cultural mother, our ecological guardian, and the living embodiment of Sanatan karuna.

mantraBox.shloka: गावो ममाग्रतो नित्यं गावः पृष्ठत एव च । गावो मे हृदये नित्यं गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम् ॥
mantraBox.translation: May cows always be before me; may cows always be behind me. May cows dwell in my heart, and may I forever reside among cows in love and seva.

taglineHeading: Located in Noida – Home to Over 100 Rescued Cows
introParas: Our Gaushala currently shelters over 100 cows, many of whom were abandoned due to old age or sickness, rescued from highway collisions, or seized from illegal butcher transport.
Here, each Gaumata is welcomed with warmth — fed, healed, and given a peaceful, green space to live out her natural life in comfort.

whyUnique.title: Daily Gauseva – Compassion In Action
whyUnique.text: Gauseva is our daily ritual. With the help of dedicated caretakers, doctors, and donors, we provide two daily meals of fresh green fodder, wheat bran, and jaggery; shaded sheds; clean drinking water; and loving touch.

pillars.title: Nutritious Diets & Fresh Green Fodder
pillars.desc: Feeding premium green feed, crushed grain, and jaggery twice every day to maintain strength and vitality.

pillars.title: On-Site Veterinary Care
pillars.desc: Daily dressing of wounds, parasite treatment, vitamin supplements, and prompt care by senior veterinarians.

pillars.title: Havan, Gau Pujan & Satsang
pillars.desc: Conducting spiritual rituals, havans, and Gau Pujan ceremonies that connect children and families to Sanatan culture.

pillars.title: Clean Shaded Sheds & Pastures
pillars.desc: Equipped with automated water troughs, clean bedding, proper drainage, and open spaces for basking in morning sunlight.

points.title: Beyond Utility
points.desc: We stand firmly against the commercial mindset of abandoning cows once they stop giving milk. Every life has intrinsic value.

points.title: Ecological Healing
points.desc: Cow dung and gomutra are utilized for organic compost and natural farm revitalization.

points.title: Family Values
points.desc: Youth and children learn empathy, kindness, and gratitude by serving Gaumata with their own hands.

specialFocus.title: Visit Our Gaushala in Noida
specialFocus.desc: We warmly invite you, your children, and your families to spend a morning at our Gaushala. Experience the peace of Gau Seva, participate in Gau Pujan, and connect with our cows.

sponsorshipTiers.title: Gau Graas for All 100+ Gaumatas for One Day
sponsorshipTiers.desc: Feeds all 100+ resident cows in the Gaushala with nutritious green feed, grains, and jaggery for an entire day.

title: Tribal Welfare
leadText: Across remote forested regions and hilly terrains, tribal communities — rich in indigenous wisdom and cultural devotion — face isolation, predatory conversions, and deep poverty. Jan Swabhiman runs a comprehensive welfare and Sanskritic reclamation initiative.

mantraBox.shloka: पाहि नो अग्ने रक्षस: पाहि धूर्तेररण्यत:। पाहि रीषत: उत वा जिघांसतो बृहद्भानो यविष्ठ्य ॥
mantraBox.translation: O Agni, protect us from deceitful enemies, protect us from wilderness dangers and exploiters. You are the ever-youthful, luminous guardian who shields the humble from harm.

introParas: Across remote forested regions and hilly terrains, tribal communities — rich in indigenous heritage — have long lived as the brave guardians of our jungles and frontiers.

Taking advantage of severe poverty, well-funded predatory conversion networks entered these regions, mocking ancient Sanatan traditions and luring innocent families away from their roots. Jan Swabhiman Welfare Society enters these villages not as outsiders, but as loving brothers, reviving self-worth, tradition, and prosperity.

whyUnique.title: Where We Work
whyUnique.text: Our field workers live and serve directly in the deepest tribal belts: Gujarat (Dang, Tapi, Valsad, Navsari), Maharashtra (Palghar, Nashik), Rajasthan (Jodhpur, Jaisalmer), Jharkhand (Garhwa, Daltonganj), and Chhattisgarh.

pillars.title: Rozgar Vyavastha – Self Employment
pillars.desc: Supplying sewing machines, welding sets, agriculture tools, and grocery kiosks to poor tribal men and women so they become financially independent.

pillars.title: Supporting Orphan & Impoverished Children
pillars.desc: Covering education costs, school uniforms, nutritious meals, and books so tribal children never abandon schooling.

pillars.title: Clothing Distribution for Families
pillars.desc: Distributing brand-new, comfortable clothes and sarees to thousands of women and children, restoring dignity and shielding them from winter cold.

pillars.title: Free Nutritious Food for Hospital Patients
pillars.desc: Serving daily hot, hygienic meals to impoverished tribal patients and attending relatives in government civil hospitals.

pillars.title: Youth Fitness, Sports & Akhadas
pillars.desc: Setting up traditional wrestling akhadas, providing cricket and volleyball kits, and channeling youth energy into community leadership.

pillars.title: Sanskritic Punarjagran (Cultural Reclamation)
pillars.desc: Organizing grand village-level Bhajan-Kirtan Yajnas, restoring village temples, celebrating Ganeshutsav and Ram Navami with massive community pride.

points.title: Standing Tall Against Deception
points.desc: Villagers who were deceived by conversion agents have returned to their ancestral traditions with deep pride and joy.

points.title: Economic Self-Reliance
points.desc: Hundreds of tribal youths run village shops and small transport businesses without migrating to urban slums.

points.title: Vibrant Community Yajnas
points.desc: Every weekend, entire tribal villages assemble for Vedic havans, bhajans, and shared Mahaprasad, obliterating caste divisions.

specialFocus.title: Vedic Bhajan-Kirtan Yajnas
specialFocus.desc: Our Dharma Jagran Yajnas are attended by 400 to 500 villagers per session, creating an unstoppable wave of Sanatani pride and cultural unity across tribal Bharat.

title: Relief Work
sanskritTitle: सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः
leadText: Standing with Communities in Crisis. At Jan Swabhiman, we stand with families and animals in times of devastating disaster — floods, droughts, and pandemics — delivering emergency food, rescue boats, and medical aid.

mantraBox.shloka: सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः । सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यन्तु मा कश्चिद्दुःखभाग्भवेत् ॥
mantraBox.translation: May all beings everywhere be happy and free. May all be healed of illness and affliction. May all see auspiciousness, and may none suffer.

introParas: When natural disasters hit vulnerable populations, the poorest families and voiceless animals bear the brunt of destruction.
Jan Swabhiman Welfare Society responds immediately with on-ground volunteer squads, reaching flooded hamlets and drought-stricken desert regions where administrative aid is slow to penetrate.

whyUnique.title: Past Critical Missions
whyUnique.text: Our relief teams take pride in zero overhead delays. Donations turn directly into food grains, clean water, tarpaulins, and medical kits delivered straight into victims' hands.

pillars.title: Assam Floods Emergency Relief
pillars.desc: During severe flood seasons, navigating boats to marooned river island villages with ration packets, baby food, clean water, and halogen lamps.

pillars.title: UP Floods – Cow & Cattle Evacuation
pillars.desc: Rescuing cattle trapped in flood currents, providing temporary dry shelters, emergency green grass, and veterinary vaccines.

pillars.title: Covid-19 Sustenance & Oxygen Aid
pillars.desc: Distributing dry rations, medicines, face masks, and providing oxygen concentrator support to daily-wage workers during lockdowns.

pillars.title: Barmer Drought Fodder Supply
pillars.desc: Sending emergency truckloads of fodder and water tankers to save thousands of cows starving in desert droughts of Rajasthan.

pillars.title: Gujarat Flash Flood Relief (Bhilad & Vansda)
pillars.desc: Running community langars for 3,000+ flood-displaced villagers and carrying out extensive sanitation and bleaching powder disinfections.

transformation.title: A Beacon When Hope Was Drowning

points.title: Immediate Ground Presence
points.desc: Our volunteers wade through waist-deep waters within hours of calamity to reach trapped families.

points.title: Inclusive Care for Humans & Animals
points.desc: We ensure that animals and cattle are rescued alongside human families, leaving no soul behind.

points.title: Long-Term Rehabilitation
points.desc: Helping rebuild damaged roofs, providing seed rations, and assisting families in restarting daily livelihood.

specialFocus.title: Transparent & Direct 80G Relief
specialFocus.desc: All disaster relief contributions are 80G tax-exempted. Every rupee donated is deployed directly to procuring grains, boats, fuel, and medical items.

sponsorshipTiers.title: Emergency Family Ration Kit
sponsorshipTiers.desc: Provides 15 days of wheat flour, rice, pulses, cooking oil, salt, biscuits, and matches for a disaster-hit family.

sponsorshipTiers.title: Medical & Flood Sanitation Kit
sponsorshipTiers.desc: Supplies essential medicines, ORS, water purification tablets, antiseptics, and bleaching powder for an entire neighborhood.

sponsorshipTiers.title: Community Langar for 300+ Displaced Victims
sponsorshipTiers.desc: Funds a day of hot cooked meals (khichdi, poori-sabzi, tea) for 300 marooned citizens in relief camps.

relatedStories.title: Assam, 2024: When Floodwaters Rose
relatedStories.subtitle: Delivering ration kits, medical supplies, and door-to-door relief with Dharma at its core

relatedStories.title: Khambaliya Village Flash Floods
relatedStories.subtitle: Rescuing marooned families, feeding villages, and restoring hope in Vansda, Gujarat

relatedStories.title: Bhilad & Valsad Flood Relief
relatedStories.subtitle: Feeding 3,000+ people, medical triage, and mass cleanup after catastrophic rainfall
